decision.title: Core and the design system are healthy; the durable defects are guard scope, one god-object, and doc/README drift — not the P0, which is correctly blocked on a recorded decision
rules: The two meta-guards must scan every workspace test root, not just apps/desktop/test one level deep.
A scan-surface guard must derive its roots rather than hardcode one directory, so a new package or nested dir cannot silently escape it.
README's 当前实现状态 must state facts derivable from the shipped artifact, not a hand-copied snapshot.
store.ts must not keep accreting unrelated concerns; splitting follows the clusters already visible in AppState.
The design SSOT records constraints; a dated section that supersedes an earlier one must edit the earlier one, not only append.
Do not re-litigate the readiness P0 here: f-25z8fff73 owns the decision and f-25q8fccdm owns the execution.

acceptance: Both meta-guards fail when a vacuous/sliced-scan offender is introduced anywhere under packages/*/test or apps/*/test, proven by adding one offender per guard and observing red.
Each guard still asserts its own scan is non-empty, and the non-empty threshold reflects the widened surface.
packages/core/test/doctor.test.ts:183 and the other vacuous assertions found in core either carry a non-empty proof or a vacuous-ok comment.
README states the ctxmux commit and protocol actually present in packages/core/vendor/ctxmux/darwin-arm64/manifest.json, and a check fails when they diverge.
README no longer claims package bin was deleted while packages/core/bin exists and package.json declares three bins.
README states the darwin-arm64-only support boundary that ctxmux-run-adapter.ts:396-397 enforces.
store.ts is split so that no single module owns both Runtime/Session state and unrelated UI preference state; behavior is unchanged and the persisted slice keeps its current narrow shape.
Every split step keeps pnpm typecheck green and leaves the 411 existing useAppStore call sites working without a compatibility shim.

findings_not_actioned.finding: RED-LINES.md commit-message gate has 0/80 compliance; the one commit adding 14 AgentMuxError throws (80826a2f) carries a single-line message
findings_not_actioned.why_not_actioned: This is a process decision for the repo owner: either enforce the gate mechanically or delete it per principle 1. Not a code task; needs the owner to pick.

findings_not_actioned.finding: docs/reviews holds 190 files / 7401 lines with only 6 referenced from code, tests, or the design SSOT
findings_not_actioned.why_not_actioned: Write-only layer. Deleting or indexing it is an owner call about process, not an implementation defect.

findings_not_actioned.finding: docs/design/agentmux-desktop-interaction.md is 93% append (added 1682 / deleted 117 lifetime), 79 of 138 H3 sections dated
findings_not_actioned.why_not_actioned: Consolidating a 1559-line SSOT is high-conflict work while peers edit it concurrently; needs a quiet window and owner agreement on what supersedes what.

findings_not_actioned.finding: browser-view-manager.ts:308 hardcodes a Google search URL and browser-profile-import-source.ts:557 special-cases google.com cookies, against principle 13
findings_not_actioned.why_not_actioned: Both are defensible (search-engine default, Chromium cookie reality) and tiny; recorded for the owner rather than churned.

findings_not_actioned.finding: Test code is 170k lines vs 103k production; apps/desktop/src/main is ~14.6% self-verification machinery (resource-probe 1095, file-editing-probe 967, recovery-probe, crash-capture*)
findings_not_actioned.why_not_actioned: Ratio observation, not a defect. No evidence any single probe is unearned; cutting would need per-probe justification.
